desc.zh: 代码托管、最新文档、错误监控与云平台
desc.en: Code hosting, up-to-date docs, error monitoring and cloud platforms

desc.zh: 团队文档、任务与工单
desc.en: Team docs, issues and tickets

desc.zh: 搜索、创建和编辑设计
desc.en: Search, create and edit designs

desc.zh: 面向 AI 的联网搜索与网页抓取
desc.en: Web search and page fetching built for AI

desc.zh: 官方技能库：读写 PDF、Word、Excel、PPT，前端设计、测试网页应用、写 MCP 服务器等（Apache-2.0）
desc.en: The official library: PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, frontend design, web app testing, building MCP servers and more (Apache-2.0)

desc.zh: 一套开发方法：头脑风暴、写计划、按计划执行、测试驱动、系统化调试、完成前验证（MIT）
desc.en: A development method: brainstorming, writing and executing plans, test-driven development, systematic debugging, verifying before done (MIT)

desc.zh: 工程实践：代码设计、领域建模、写规格再实现、TDD、代码审查、排查缺陷（MIT）
desc.en: Engineering practice: codebase design, domain modelling, spec then implement, TDD, code review, diagnosing bugs (MIT)

desc.zh: 生产级工程技能：前端工程、性能优化、安全加固、无障碍、API 设计、CI/CD（MIT）
desc.en: Production engineering: frontend, performance, security hardening, accessibility, API design, CI/CD (MIT)

desc.zh: 界面与视觉设计：设计系统、UI 风格、品牌、横幅与演示稿（MIT）
desc.en: Interface and visual design: design systems, UI styling, brand, banners and slides (MIT)

desc.zh: 仓库、Issue、PR 与 Actions（GitHub 官方远程服务器）
desc.en: Repos, issues, pull requests and Actions (GitHub's official remote server)

setup.zh: 在 GitHub › Settings › Developer settings 创建一个 Personal access token（建议勾选 repo 和 read:org），粘贴到这里。令牌保存在系统钥匙串里。
setup.en: Create a personal access token in GitHub › Settings › Developer settings (repo and read:org are a good start) and paste it here. The token is kept in the system keychain.

desc.zh: 按版本检索开源库的最新文档和示例代码
desc.en: Up-to-date, version-specific docs and code examples for libraries

setup.zh: 不填 API key 也能用；填写后额度更高。
setup.en: Works without an API key; adding one raises the rate limit.

desc.zh: 就任意公开 GitHub 仓库提问、阅读其文档
desc.en: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo and read its docs

desc.zh: 查看错误、Issue 与性能数据并分析原因
desc.en: Look into errors, issues and performance data

desc.zh: 通过一个服务器管理 Workers、DNS、R2 等整个 Cloudflare API
desc.en: The whole Cloudflare API (Workers, DNS, R2 …) through one server

desc.zh: 检索 Cloudflare 开发者文档
desc.en: Search Cloudflare's developer documentation

desc.zh: 查询客户、付款与订阅，检索 Stripe 文档
desc.en: Customers, payments and subscriptions, plus Stripe's docs

desc.zh: 搜索模型、数据集、Spaces 和论文
desc.en: Search models, datasets, Spaces and papers

setup.zh: 不填令牌即可匿名使用部分工具；填写 access token 后可用全部工具（在 huggingface.co/settings/mcp 选择）。
setup.en: Some tools work anonymously; with an access token you get the tools you pick at huggingface.co/settings/mcp.

desc.zh: 用 Chrome 调试网页：看网络请求、控制台、性能，截图和操作页面（Google 官方）
desc.en: Debug pages in Chrome: network, console, performance, screenshots and page actions (Google's official server)

setup.zh: 需要这台电脑装有 Google Chrome。浏览器在后台无界面运行，用独立的临时配置，不会碰你自己的 Chrome 和登录状态。
setup.en: Needs Google Chrome on this computer. It runs headless with its own throwaway profile, never your own Chrome or its sign-ins.

desc.zh: 用 Playwright 自动操作浏览器：打开网页、点击、填表、截图（微软官方，下载量最高的 MCP）
desc.en: Drive a browser with Playwright: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots (Microsoft's official server, the most downloaded MCP)

setup.zh: 需要这台电脑装有 Google Chrome。和 Crewbase 自带的浏览器工具功能有重叠，习惯用 Playwright 的可以加上。
setup.en: Needs Google Chrome on this computer. It overlaps with Crewbase's built-in browser tools; add it if you prefer Playwright.

desc.zh: 管理 Supabase 项目：数据库表与 SQL、迁移、日志、Edge Functions（官方远程服务器）
desc.en: Manage Supabase projects: tables and SQL, migrations, logs, Edge Functions (official remote server)

setup.zh: 用 Supabase 账号登录授权。建议先在开发项目上用，避免 Agent 改到生产数据。
setup.en: Sign in with your Supabase account. Start with a development project so agents never touch production data.

desc.zh: 搜索、阅读和编辑 Notion 页面与数据库
desc.en: Search, read and edit Notion pages and databases

desc.zh: 查找、创建和更新 Issue、项目与评论
desc.en: Find, create and update issues, projects and comments

desc.zh: Jira 工单与 Confluence 页面（Atlassian Rovo MCP）
desc.en: Jira issues and Confluence pages (Atlassian Rovo MCP)

setup.zh: 组织管理员可能需要先允许这个应用。
setup.en: Your organisation's admin may need to allow the connection first.

desc.zh: 搜索、创建和编辑 Canva 设计
desc.en: Search, create and edit Canva designs

desc.zh: 抓取整站或单页并转成干净的 Markdown，也能搜索和批量提取
desc.en: Crawl whole sites or single pages into clean Markdown; search and batch extraction too

setup.zh: 不填 API key 每天有免费额度；在 firecrawl.dev 注册后填写 key 可以用更多。
setup.en: Works on a free daily allowance without a key; add a key from firecrawl.dev for more.

desc.zh: 面向 AI 的联网搜索与网页抓取
desc.en: Web search and page fetching built for AI

setup.zh: 不填 API key 有免费额度；填写后不受限。
setup.en: Works on a free rate limit without a key; add one to lift it.

desc.zh: 审查改动：先找缺陷，再谈风格，给出可执行的意见
desc.en: Review a change for bugs first, style second, with actionable comments

desc.zh: 从改动写出清楚的提交信息和 PR 描述
desc.en: Write clear commit messages and pull request descriptions from a diff

desc.zh: 复现、缩小、定位并修好一个失败的测试
desc.en: Reproduce, narrow down, find and fix a failing test

desc.zh: 把提交记录或变更日志整理成给用户看的发布说明
desc.en: Turn commits or a changelog into release notes people want to read

desc.zh: 联网调研：交叉核对来源，每条结论都附引用
desc.en: Research the web, cross-check sources and cite every claim

desc.zh: 用 Python 分析表格 / CSV，给出结论和可复现的脚本
desc.en: Analyse a spreadsheet or CSV with Python, with findings and a reproducible script

desc.zh: 把会议记录整理成决定、待办（负责人 + 截止日）和未决问题
desc.en: Turn meeting notes into decisions, action items with owners and dates, and open questions

desc.zh: 从笔记、提交和任务整理出一份简短的周报
desc.en: Write a short weekly report from notes, commits and tasks
